title: skills/docs: ADR-0087 D1 and D3 still promise a replay command that the refusal no longer carries below the support floor or ahead of the runtime
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTEivi2wogPpeo3xd5

Found by area S3 while delivering #33618 (PR #34026, the ledger comment and checklist text for `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE`). This is a governed-text follow-up for the skills lane. The server lane does not edit `docs/adr/**`.

**What the shipped refusal does** (`checkProtocolCompat`, as stated in PR #34026's ledger comment):
- `migrateCommand` is `objectstack migrate meta --from N` only when the target sits between the support floor (16) and the runtime major.
- It is absent when the target is ahead of the runtime (#26480) or below the floor (#33466). In both cases the message names the two remedies instead.

**What the ADR still says** (`docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md` on main):
- `:116` (D1): the diagnostic carries "the exact replay command (`objectstack migrate meta --from <N>`, D3)", with no floor or ahead-of-runtime qualification.
- `:191` (D3): "`objectstack migrate meta --from 10` composes the steps 10→11→…→current". Below the floor the CLI refuses `--from 10` (`MigrationFloorError`), and the same ADR records the floor at 16 (`:1492`).
- `:536`: "`migrate meta --from 10` therefore reaches protocol 15". This may be a dated record of the pre-launch era. If so, it can stay as history with a pointer to the floor amendment. The skills lane decides.

**Ask:** amend D1 and D3 so the promised command is scoped to the floor and the runtime major, and name the two remedies the refusal gives outside that window. The text is governed, so it follows the skills lane's ADR amendment route.

Prior rulings read: #33466 (floor 16, no command below it), #26480 (no command ahead of the runtime), #33618 ruling Q2 = A (`targetMajor` on every refusal). Dedupe: an open-issue search for "ADR-0087" with floor and `migrate meta` found no card on these lines.
